scope: Original AP2 shopper payment and OTP tools, merchant, processor, credentials provider and SDK task stores; owned prefix decisions, offline fixtures and in-process ASGI. These are application development cells, not full ADK shopper tasks, MCP bridge qualification or human-approved gold.
cell_order: case-major, arm-minor, exactly the ordered Cartesian product below

arms.description: Source-reference equivalent: valid source-sender state under the same offline/ASGI intervention; wrong or absent human responses remain adverse.
Unchanged original tool return and received caller state. Generic input-required text alone supplies no OTP. No Task read or repair.
One legal original SDK Task read; restore already-observed sender identity/mandates or invoke an omitted original credential association. No admission. Recipient transport loss remains unrepairable.
Check actual received original-tool request against canonical public observations. No state repair or omitted association execution.
The same legal public recovery followed by independently checked shared admission, with another freshness check before the original ASGI handler.

cases.description: The original tool hides the real input-required challenge in its generic return.
Explicit development human/demo reply; preserve original source values.
Explicit wrong public reply. No arm may replace it with the demo hint.
No human reply. Wait even though the public demo challenge offers a hint.
Replace continuation authority with an actual earlier completed original merchant catalog Task ID.
Replace merchant authority with the actual nested processor Task ID retained in the challenge.
Use the actual context from a separate original catalog allocation in this same fresh worker.
Remove the required payment mandate from the caller after original payment start; retain the original source RuntimeError before message construction.
Use the actual original checkout mandate in the payment-mandate slot.
Omit the original signed-mandate association step in received arms; retain actual credential-lookup behavior.
Declared owned transport perturbation removes the payment DataPart after unchanged original message construction. Public sender and received raw request are retained separately.
Invoke the original OTP tool twice; retain real terminal-task SDK behavior or once-only admission refusal.
A prospectively declared one-second finite-model interval with a real two-second pre-handler delay. Other arms receive the same delay.
